system.description:
Scout-Nin Keyword: Specialized

As a bonus action, when 2 or more members of your Squad are engaged with the same creature, you can command them to perform a pincer strike by spending 1 Superiority Die. Each engaged Squad-Mate can make an unarmed or weapon attack targeting the same hostile creature, adding your superiority die to their damage dealt. For each successful strike, the affected hostile creature suffers a -1 penalty to their next saving throw from a Jutsu you cast before the end of your current turn.
